about.title: About ENPEE International School
about.description: Learn about ENPEE International School, its beginnings, educational approach and core values in Karaikal.

sections.heading: Our beginnings
sections.body: ENPEE International School began its academic journey in 2019 on a green campus in Karaikal. The school describes its approach as focused on academic learning, creativity, character and the development of the whole child.

sections.heading: Our vision
sections.body: The school aims to offer quality education informed by international standards and to help young learners grow through new learning experiences.

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: ENPEE’s stated mission includes developing skilled educators, providing a safe and child-friendly environment, and creating modern learning facilities for the community.

sections.heading: Our motto and core values
sections.body: Knowledge, Innovation and Excellence guide the school’s educational philosophy.

sections.heading: CBSE method of education
sections.body: The school describes its teaching approach as following the CBSE method and using NCERT learning materials. Refer to the latest CBSE Mandatory Disclosure for current affiliation details.

sections.heading: Six areas of focus
sections.body: The school highlights these strengths in its official materials.

promoters.title: Promoters
promoters.description: Explore the institutional background of ENPEE International School and its promoters.

sections.heading: National Pharma Group
sections.body: The school’s official profile traces National Pharma to a pharmaceutical manufacturing unit established in Thanjavur in 1967. It describes the group’s growth from an early formulation to a broader range of products and regional reach.

sections.heading: Healthcare and community service
sections.body: The National Pharma Hospital and Research Institute was established in Thanjavur in 2010, with medical services beginning in 2011. The school’s profile describes the hospital as part of the group’s wider healthcare work.

sections.heading: Founder and recognition
sections.body: The official school website identifies Rtn. PHF. Hajee L. Kamal Batcha as Founder and Chairman. It lists recognitions including Jamnalal Bajaj Merit Certificates and CHEMEXCIL export awards.
bullets: CHEMEXCIL Export Promotion Award / Merit Certificate

sections.heading: Design philosophy
sections.body: The school describes a design shaped by the character of its location, with open surroundings and a “less is more” approach to the campus.

sections.heading: Design code
sections.body: The design makes use of the site’s existing features and follows the linear shape of the land, with buildings arranged according to their functions.

sections.heading: Form and function
sections.body: Building orientation is intended to support natural light and ventilation. The official description also notes the value of retaining the existing landscape.

sections.heading: Empathy and focus
sections.body: The architecture draws on Karaikal’s French-colonial heritage while reflecting the character of the local setting.
